{{nihongo|'''Toi Shrine'''|土肥神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Toi Shrine'''（といじんじゃ）is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Toi, Shizuoka|fa|توی، شیزوئوکا|fr|Toi (Shizuoka)|it|Toi (Giappone)|ja|土肥町|ko|도이정 (시즈오카현)|ur|ٹوئی، شیزوکا|qid=Q3530413|lt=Toi}}, {{ill|Izu, Shizuoka|ar|إزو (شيزوكا)|arz|ازو (تجمع سكان فى محافظه شيزوكا)|azb|ایزو، شیزوئوکا|ce|Идзу (гӀала)|ceb|Izu (lungsod)|cs|Izu (Šizuoka)|de|Izu (Shizuoka)|es|Izu (Shizuoka)|et|Izu|fa|ایزو، شیزوئوکا|fi|Izu (Shizuoka)|fr|Izu|gl|Izu, Shizuoka|id|Izu, Shizuoka|it|Izu (Shizuoka)|ja|伊豆市|ko|이즈시|lt|Idzu|mzn|ایزو، شیزوئوکا|nl|Izu (Shizuoka)|pl|Izu|pt|Izu (Shizuoka)|ro|Izu|ru|Идзу (город)|sv|Izu, Shizuoka|tg|Изу|tl|Izu|tr|Izu, Şizuoka|tt|Идзу (шәһәр)|uk|Ідзу (Сідзуока)|ur|ایزو، شیزوکا|vi|Izu, Shizuoka|war|Izu, Shizuoka|zh|伊豆市|zh_classical|伊豆市|zh_min_nan|Izu-chhī|zh_yue|伊豆市|qid=Q696840}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}. It is the district's {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sōchinju}} (general tutelary shrine)<ref name="s-np"/>.

== Overview ==
Its founding date is unknown, but it is presumed to be very old, predating the Heian period, because it is regarded as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} candidate for "Toyomitama-no-Mikoto Shrine" listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} under {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Izu Province|ja|伊豆国の式内社一覧|qid=Q11380552|lt=Naka District of Izu Province}}<ref name="yuisho">Precinct origin board</ref>.

== Cultural property ==
* Toi Shrine "Satsuma-korogashi"（city-designated folk cultural property<ref>[http://www.city.izu.shizuoka.jp/gyousei/gyousei_detail006921.html City-designated folk cultural properties] - Izu City</ref>）- a festival chant sung at Setsubun and the grand annual festival banquet.
